results.description: A lush Christmas tree adorned with ornaments sits atop a woven wicker tree skirt, resting on a light-colored rug.

A product photograph shows the base of a decorated Christmas tree with a woven basket-style tree collar. The image is a close-up, eye-level view focused on the lower portion of an artificial evergreen tree adorned with metallic ornaments and warm white string lights. Hanging from the branches are large spherical baubles in shiny silver, champagne gold, and copper tones, along with smaller elongated teardrop-shaped ornaments in clear glass with silver caps. The tree sits inside a wide, cylindrical woven collar made of natural light-tan fibers, likely water hyacinth, with a tight basketweave pattern and visible stitching around the rim. The collar encircles the trunk area, concealing the stand. The scene is set on a light wood floor; to the left edge, partially visible wrapped gifts appear — one in brown paper with striped ribbon and another in beige wrapping. The lighting is bright and even, highlighting the texture of the weave and the reflective surfaces of the ornaments. No people, text overlays, or branding are visible in the frame.
A lush, decorated Christmas tree stands above a large woven basket, adorned with ornaments and red berries.
A large, woven wicker tree skirt sits beneath a decorated Christmas tree adorned with lights and ornaments.

results.description: A decorated Christmas tree sits in a woven wicker basket, adorned with lights and a plaid ribbon.

A close-up product-style photo shows the base of an artificial Christmas tree seated in a woven wicker tree collar on a light wood floor. The upper portion of the frame is filled with dense green faux fir branches strung with small warm-white pre-lit lights that are illuminated, glowing against the needles. The lower two-thirds of the image focuses on the tree skirt alternative: a wide, shallow basket made of natural-toned rattan or wicker with tight horizontal weaving and a decorative braided scalloped trim along the top rim. The collar sits squarely on pale, wide-plank flooring with visible wood grain. The lighting is soft and even, highlighting the texture of the woven material and the plastic texture of the artificial needles. No people, text, or additional decorations are visible; the shot is tightly cropped to emphasize the tree base and skirt, presenting a cozy, domestic holiday aesthetic.

A close-up product-style photograph shows the base of an artificial Christmas tree set inside a large woven wicker tree collar. The image is framed from floor level upward, capturing the lower trunk and dense green branches emerging from a dark brown, trapezoidal wicker basket that encircles the stand. The weave is tight and rustic, with visible texture and slight variations in tone across the material. To the right and left edges, partially wrapped gifts in red-and-green plaid paper sit on a light wood herringbone floor, with warm white fairy lights tangled around them, glowing softly. A cream-colored rug with a subtle pattern occupies the bottom foreground. The background includes a white baseboard and wall. No people, text overlays, or branding are visible. The overall tone is cozy and festive, presenting a holiday decor setup focused on concealing the tree stand with a decorative wicker cover.
A woven wicker tree skirt with red and blue accents sits beneath a decorated Christmas tree adorned with lights and greenery.

A close-up view of the base of a decorated Christmas tree with a woven tree collar. The image shows the lower portion of the tree, focusing on a wide, flared basket made of woven natural fibers resembling wicker or seagrass in a light brown tone, which encircles the trunk area. Above the collar, the tree's green fir branches are visible, adorned with small warm white string lights and clusters of artificial red berries. In the foreground on the wooden floor, several Christmas ornaments are scattered: a red glittery bauble and a green glittery bauble with a gold cap in the lower left, and in the background to the right, a green ornament with white polka dots and a partially visible red ornament. The overall tone is festive and decorative, suggesting a holiday setting focused on Christmas tree presentation and decoration. The image is static with no people or movement, emphasizing the texture of the woven collar and the holiday decor elements.

A close-up product shot shows the base of an artificial Christmas tree sitting inside a woven wicker tree collar on a rustic wooden floor. The image is framed tightly around the lower trunk and the collar, with green pine needles filling the top portion of the frame and the light brown, open-weave wicker basket encircling the trunk at the bottom. The collar is wide and shallow, with a natural tan color and a textured basketweave pattern, resting directly on weathered wood planks that show grain and dark stains. No people, text, logos, or other objects are visible; the background is plain white behind the foliage. The overall tone is clean and commercial, presenting a decorative holiday accessory in a home setting.
